subject: Bayesian inference: updating beliefs about unknown quantities with data, using priors, likelihoods and posteriors
outOfScope: The internals of MCMC algorithms, such as the mathematics of Metropolis-Hastings and Hamiltonian Monte Carlo
Variational inference and other approximate inference methods
Hierarchical and multilevel models in depth
Specific Bayesian software, such as PyMC, Stan or rstanarm
Bayesian regression and generalised linear models beyond the idea of a posterior predictive check
Bayesian deep learning and Bayesian neural networks
Deriving conjugate posteriors by hand beyond the beta-binomial case
